result:
C round 148 **passes**. I ran every browser check that can run here in real Chromium at both 1440×900 and 1280×720, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. I found no bugs, and no source file changed while I was testing.

- **Video dock text:** every label, caption, button name, tooltip and status in the dock is the exact English from the task. That covers the empty dock, the dock with the test video loaded, the gap, the expanded view and all three ways back (Escape, Return, ✕). One ArrowRight on the drag handle moves the expanded video exactly 16 px.
- **Gap timer:** the gap readout (`No video · 00:08.000`) counts up in real time during playback. Undo removed the clip I added for that test.
- **Play failure:** when video playback is refused, the exact English error message appears in 37–38 ms and the playhead stays stopped.
- **Video sync:** video and playhead never drift more than 0.008 s apart (the limit is 0.12 s), and the video track's sound plays.
- **Page title and language:** the title is `Studio Lab — Demo workspace | CZABA` in both the browser and the server-rendered HTML, and the page language is `en`.
- **No Georgian left:** I scanned the whole page in ten states, including the Export dialog, a failed sound load and library preview. The only Georgian is the allowed demo sound titles.
- **Layout:** nothing outside the dock moved more than 1 px. Every larger shift inside the dock comes from the shorter English text. Two of those shifts go slightly beyond the task's written exception, so I flagged them for B to rule on:
  - the caption's grey note keeps its right edge fixed;
  - the "Video expanded" text keeps its centre fixed.
- **RV-1 re-capture:** two runs per viewport matched to 0 px in all six states. The new reference files are `bbox-post-v0-{1280,1440}.json`, and the older round-125 baseline files are untouched.
- **Premium sign-in is not bypassed:** a fresh anonymous browser opens the demo page, but `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace and no audio. `/api/studio-token` returns 401.
- **Network and errors:** no blocked requests, no Authorization headers, and no hydration or page errors. The only errors were the expected cart noise.
- **A's tests:** my rerun of A's 13 test files matched exactly (215/215).

One check is blocked: the fake-token request that should return 403 needs the backend, which isn't available in the cloud. One capture failed on the very first page load while the dev server was still starting up; the rerun was clean and is logged as an invalid run.

The full suite, typecheck, build, verify and e2e smoke are left to the root gate.

Files are in /home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop:
- c-round-148.md
- c-round-148.json
- c-round-148/ (tools, measurements and screenshots in tools/, out/, shots/)
